title: Assassin Of Werewolf
description:
STORY:Assassin of Werewolf is 3rd person RPG adventure game, where player control brave and powerful woman character Leslie who are world only hope to beat Werewolf bosses in 8 different levels and save valuable skulls. Every level player mission is to kill Werewolf boss and avoid his army which contains different enemies like sword enemy and archer enemy who can shoot different and deathful arrow. Leslie character need find boss Werewolf. Werewolf boss is weak but he has different attack styles. By defeating Werewolf boss  gate will be destroyed and player can collect valuable skull which she need to collect to finish levels. Skulls gives player steam achievements. 

Player can use different weapons like sword and 2 different arrows: normal and explosive. Also player have 20 health potions to use every level. So can you be brave woman warrior and save world from big bad Werewolf bosses and his army and collect all missing skulls. 

FEATURES:• 8 levels

• enemies with sword and enemies with archer

• Health potion system

• Player has swords and archer and 2 different bows

• Werewolf boss with different attacks.  Killing boss destroy gate and then player can collect skull and finish levels
description_short: Player controls Woman Warrior in this 3rd person rpg adventure. His mission is to kill Werewolf and his army in different maps and find valuable skulls and finish levels
